É muita história para contar...

Desde o século XIX a Granado atravessa gerações encantando seus consumidores com produtos de qualidade e com uma pegada sustentável. São mais de 150 anos e, desde sua fundação, a marca sempre soube manter valores sólidos e estar atenta às necessidades de seu tempo. Cresceu e rejuvenesceu sem perder a essência.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza o equilíbrio e o consumo consciente, recentemente a CARE se uniu à Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem-estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

Join to apply for the Digital Media QA Specialist role at Launch Potato

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

CONTRACT NON-NEGOTIABLES

  • Available to work 40 hours per week, Monday - Friday.
  • Comfortable working somewhere between 7:00 am to 6:00 pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • Highly detail-oriented and reliable.
  • Excellent administrative skills with the ability to multitask and adapt in a fast-paced remote environment.

YOUR ROLE

You are a detail-oriented, results-driven professional with a passion for maintaining the highest standards of quality and efficiency in operational processes and procedures. Everything goes through QA, so you will be directly responsible for ensuring the success of our campaign launches which connect millions of consumers to our clients monthly! You will also be responsible for overseeing and optimizing our operations to ensure they meet and exceed industry standards and organizational objectives.

Your unwavering attention to detail and thorough analysis skills will be invaluable in detecting and identifying potential problems within our daily operations. Additionally, you have a proven track record in quality management, process improvement, and possess industry-specific knowledge. Your ability to collaborate and work cross-functionally, leveraging your industry-specific expertise, will enable you to implement effective solutions, making a significant impact on our company's operational excellence.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Supporting quality assurance for our financebuzz.com and allaboutcookies.org domains.
  • Maintaining the currently implemented process for building, setting up, and testing tracking URLs across all campaigns and platforms to ensure the highest quality.
  • Reconciling reporting between our internal tracking platforms and external client platforms to ensure proper tracking.
  • Conducting investigations when there is an offer discrepancy or malfunction and finding suitable resolutions.
  • Reviewing platform documentation and internal product setup to find areas of improvement and working with the Operations team to determine next steps to close the gap.
  • Working closely with the Operations team to ensure QA standards are consistently met.
  • Communicating with internal stakeholders on process improvements.
  • Analyzing ad hoc performance reports to improve company efficiency of revenue delivery, product improvement, or general site issues.
  • Monitoring revenue, conversions, impressions, and clicks to ensure proper reporting when a new offer is created, links are changed, or in other necessary circumstances.
  • Monitoring offer goals to ensure all goals are firing properly after creation.
  • Ensuring QA is successfully implemented with any new process that is rolled out.
  • Quickly becoming a subject matter expert for all QA related processes.

What You Need To Succeed

  • 2-3 years in operations or quality assurance and expertise in digital media advertising.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Understanding of Postback URL tracking and other performance marketing methods of tracking.
  • Experience with Tune & Yieldspark or similar tracking tools.
  • Experience with Asana or other project management tools.
  • Experience with Looker or similar BI tools like Tableau or PowerBI.
  • Proven abilities to analyze performance reports to improve company efficiency of revenue delivery, product improvement, or general site issues.
  • Proven problem solving abilities and #BetterEveryDay mindset.
  • You are proactive and will search for opportunities, not just being given tasks/tickets.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to work East Coast hours consistently.

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Tax Coordinator - Rio

Hanwha Ocean | Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil | Requisition ID: 1283

Description

Hanwha Ocean is undergoing a transformative journey, evolving from a traditional shipbuilder to an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation, and Operation (EPCI(O)) solution provider, offering products such as FPSO, FLNG, Offshore Renewables and other Floating Production Units.

The Energy Plant Unit Division recently expanded its global footprint by establishing a new Global Business Center with the intention of becoming a project-centric and client-driven organization. This transformation enhances our ability to deliver exceptional project execution and knowledge-driven operational models by bridging the upstream culture of Asia, Europe, and America.

Explore opportunities to be part of our dynamic team and contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine the offshore industry.

Position Overview

The Tax Coordinator at Hanwha Ocean Brazil plays a key role in supporting the company’s tax strategy and compliance activities within the complex regulatory environment of Brazil. This position is responsible for executing the accurate calculation, reporting and payment of the due taxes, ensuring full adherence to local legislation and industry‑specific requirements. The Tax Coordinator will lead routine tax obligations, act on audits, manage tax documentation and evaluate the fiscal impacts of operational and commercial activities. This role is key to improving tax processes, identifying opportunities for efficiency and mitigating tax risks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute the calculation, booking and settlement of corporate taxes, including IRPJ/CSLL and indirect taxes such as PIS and CONFINS.
  • Prepare, review, and submit all required tax reports and filings in compliance with federal, state, and municipal regulations.
  • Act on tax processes (IRRF, ISS, ICMS) ensuring accurate application and timely remittance.
  • Prepare and submit mandatory indirect tax declarations (eg. DCTF, perpComp, DIRF).
  • Design internal tax procedures that foster cost reductions and mitigation of compliance risks.
  • Perform reconciliations between fiscal and accounting records, ensuring accuracy of direct and indirect tax accounts.
  • Monitor changes in tax legislation and assess their operational and financial impacts on the business.
  • Provide tax guidance and support internal teams across the organization.
  • Prepare responses, gather supporting documentation and ensure the correctness of tax information provided in audits.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Solid experience in tax operations within Brazil, preferably in the oil and gas or energy industries with more than 7 years in the role.
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian tax legislation, including direct and indirect taxes (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, CONFINS, ICMS, ISS, IRRF).
  • Experience with tax filings and ancillary obligations.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast‑paced environment.

title: Metering Engineer
description:

This position will support FPSO operations by overseeing and ensuring the integrity of all metering systems. It will involve monitoring system performance, validating data, and providing daily operational support. The role will also act as the Technical Authority for metering, ensuring compliance with technical and regulatory requirements, including ANP and INMETRO standards.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for ensuring that all fluid metering systems at FPSO are performed in accordance with the technical requirements and legal deadlines, meeting the requirements outlined in Joint Resolution ANP / INMETRO 01: 2013 (RTM)
  • Provide technical support daily, in relation to measurement problems in the FPSO
  • Participate or assist in metering audits
  • Act as Technical Authority for measurement issues
  • Verify that FPSO operator's procedures and manuals are in accordance with current ANP, ISO and other relevant standards for offshore oil and natural gas flow measurement (fiscal, allocation and operational)
  • Manage and monitor the status of the flow metering systems (fiscal, allocation and operational)
  • Conduct critical analysis of failure reports, calibrations and periodic maintenance of fiscal, allocation and custody transfer metering systems in accordance with RTM and applicable standards
  • Verify, validate and submit data (failure reports, flow computer data, well test reports and monthly production report) related to the FPSO metering systems to ANP
  • Keep measurement points registered in the SFP (ANP production system) updated
  • Validate offloading measurement reports
  • Verify the operational history of seal removal and installation
  • Verify that the FPSO operator is following calibration plans, uncertainty calculations, and required flow computer upgrades
  • Verify / validate in case of measurement system failure the volume estimate as specified in ANP resolutions
  • Verify / monitor backups of measurement equipment information, fault history, equipment replacement, and parameter changes
  • Carry out the planning and control of the sample collection service for chemical analysis, interface with logistics for loading and unloading materials related to the samples, and, if necessary, validate the results of PVT and chromatographic analysis. After validation, monitor the results/inform the need to update the flow computers
  • Follow up on routines to keep the Metering Management System in operation without non-conformities

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Automation, Petroleum, Production, Chemical Engineering or related

Knowledge and Skills

  • Good understanding and knowledge of FPSO marine & process systems
  • Familiar with engineering/industry standards such as API, ASME, ASTM, NACE, etc.
  • Advanced English (oral and written)

Seniority level

  • Mid-Senior level
